<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/firmware/upgradable-devices/search-by-device-ids"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Query upgradable firmware within a specified set of devices.
Rules: `deviceIds` is required, minimum 1, maximum 200, and must be deduplicated; type filtering is optional, `excludeDeviceTypes` takes precedence over `includeDeviceTypes`.
